There are 85 types of candy.

>Q3. What is your favorite candy (other than Twix) in the dataset and what is it’s winpercent value?

My favorite candy in the dataset is M&M's. It's winpercent value is 66.57458.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(dplyr)

candy |> 
  filter(row.names(candy)=="M&M's") |> 
  select(winpercent)
```

